description: List audits for a specific Zendesk ticket, including events such as comments and changes. Supports offset and cursor pagination; retrieve subsequent pages to view the audit history.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing audits for a specific Zendesk ticket.

filter_events.description: Filter audit events by type. Use the format filter_events[]=Type1&filter_events[]=Type2 to include only specific event types.
filter_events.human_parameter_description: Filter to only show specific audit event types like Comment, Notification, etc.
filter_events.title: Filter Events

include.description: A comma-separated list of sideloads to include in the response (e.g., 'users,groups').
include.human_parameter_description: Request additional related data like users or groups to be included with the audit results.
include.title: Include

include_boundary_indicators.description: When true, includes 'has_more' indicator in the cursor pagination response meta. Only valid with cursor pagination (page[size], page[after], page[before]).
include_boundary_indicators.human_parameter_description: Show indicators for whether there are more results beyond current page.
include_boundary_indicators.title: Include Boundary Indicators

include_item_cursors.description: When true, includes cursor values for each item in the cursor pagination response. Only valid with cursor pagination (page[size], page[after], page[before]).
include_item_cursors.human_parameter_description: Show cursor values for each individual audit item.
include_item_cursors.title: Include Item Cursors

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination. Traditional: ?page=2 (integer page number). Cursor: ?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive - use one format or the other, not both.
page.human_parameter_description: Which page of audit results you want to view. Start at 1 and increase to browse through more audits.
page.title: Page

page_after.description: Cursor value to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous response's next_page link.
page_after.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the next set of audit results.
page_after.title: Page After

page_before.description: Cursor value to retrieve the previous page of results. Obtained from previous response's previous_page link.
page_before.human_parameter_description: Cursor token from the previous page to get the previous set of audit results.
page_before.title: Page Before

page_size.description: Number of audits per page for cursor pagination (max 100). Use with page[after] or page[before] for cursor-based pagination.
page_size.human_parameter_description: Number of audit records per page using cursor-based pagination.
page_size.title: Page Size

sort_by.description: Field to sort results by. Prefix with '-' for descending order. When used with cursor pagination, this determines the cursor ordering.
sort_by.human_parameter_description: Pick the audit field to sort by (e.g., created_at) so results appear in the order you prefer.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.description: Sort order for the results. Defaults to 'asc' if not specified.
sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose ascending (asc) or descending (desc) sort order for audit results.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

ticket_id.description: The ID of the ticket to retrieve audits for.
ticket_id.human_parameter_description: The unique identifier of the Zendesk ticket. You can find this ID in the ticket URL or from a ticket list.
ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
